name: banner-push-in
title: Banner Push-In
description: A notification banner fades in and rises into place while every banner already on screen slides up one pitch in lockstep, so arrivals stack instead of overlapping
author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Width
variables.description: Banner width in pixels; icon and type scale with it.

variables.label: Rise
variables.description: How far a banner rises into place while it fades in.

variables.label: Pitch
variables.description: How far the stack slides up when a new banner arrives.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Glass for footage and bright grounds, solid for flat compositions.
